gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-thaana: Dreamy and spaced out, Starborn leaves wide gaps between letters under a dark stripe of lowercase. Noto Sans Thaana does the quieter job, with generous channels leading into each counter and big open forms.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-thai: Rounded lowercase puffed up like glass beads, with every curve left open, gives Noto Sans Thai its friendly read. Starborn floats above it, dreamy and widely spaced, while Noto Sans Thai keeps the text grounded.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-thai-lo: Starborn spreads its letters far apart, a dark, thick band of lowercase running through each line. Noto Sans Thai Looped sits below it with tall bodies that look bold, and curve ends left spacious.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-tirhuta: Terminals cut back to leave big gaps and a dominant x-height give Noto Sans Tirhuta a contemporary, clean look. Starborn is the dreamier partner, its widely spaced letters forming a thick, dark stripe through each line.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-ugariti: Noto Sans Ugaritic sits tight between x-height and cap height, its letter mouths open like unjoined chalk arcs. Starborn does the dreaming, with wide gaps between letters, and the body font handles the everyday reading.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-vai: Starborn is ethereal and dreamy, its letters set far apart in a thick, dark stripe of lowercase. Noto Sans Vai answers with solid word blocks.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-vithkuq: Clean and modern, Noto Sans Vithkuqi has open throats on its a, c, e, and s. Starborn adds dreamy distance above, and the small step from capitals to lowercase would keep a longer read smooth.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-wancho: Noto Sans Wancho reads hulking, like thick chalk pressed hard. Starborn floats over it in a dreamy stripe of spaced lowercase, while Noto Sans Wancho keeps the text weighty with an e that has a wide terminal gap.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-warang-: Huge gaps between letters make Starborn dreamy, with a dark, thick lowercase stripe through every line. Noto Sans Warang Citi forms solid word blocks with wide channels into each counter, so a longer read would flow without snagging.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-zanabaz: Noto Sans Zanabazar Square soars with a tall x-height and wide gaps that keep tiny sizes crisp. Starborn adds the dreamy, widely spaced stripe.
